title: Context-intelligence Unit B: unified bounded context compiler consuming the deterministic index (D-013)
objective: Make the ONE context pack (tools/context_pack.py) consume the deterministic index under ONE global budget with coverage/provenance emission, refuse-or-split on overflow, and the owner-approved explicit amendment introducing the adaptive 5K-8K normal tier (owner decision 7) to the accepted 32K/64K/20% budget contract; never silently rewrite the accepted contract.
business_reason: D-013 Unit B; single-compiler principle (no independent concatenated budgets).

acceptance_scenarios.given: a fixture repo with a task packet, diff, and code-graph neighborhood
acceptance_scenarios.when: the context pack is built consuming the deterministic index
acceptance_scenarios.then: exactly one context.md is produced whose meta records ONE total budget (budget.single_total_budget=true, one effective_bound_bytes shared by all sources; no per-source budgets) (D-013-R039/R040)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a small change with low dependency breadth and no --target-tokens override
acceptance_scenarios.then: budget.tier.tier=='normal', the adaptive target is within [5000,8000], budget.tier.hard_ceiling_unchanged==true, and budget.amendment.changes_constants==false (D-013-R041/R080)

acceptance_scenarios.given: high dependency breadth but no tier justification
acceptance_scenarios.when: the pack is built, then rebuilt WITH a justification
acceptance_scenarios.then: without justification the target is NOT silently raised above normal (the withheld larger target is recorded); with justification tier=='medium' and the target never exceeds the accepted 32,000 contract (D-013-R041/R042)

it carries snapshot_fingerprint, git HEAD/branch/dirty_state_digest, source_manifest_digest, export_digest, indexer/schema/eligibility versions, index mode/rebuild_reason, and a census with reconciles==true plus a coverage-mode label (D-013-R023/R024/R002)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a large material --include under a tiny byte budget
acceptance_scenarios.then: it refuses with a split proposal (overflow.resolved=='split_required'), material is preserved as evidence and never silently truncated, and the hard ceiling remains min(ordinary,relative) — the tier target never relaxes the ceiling (D-013-R003/R013/R040)
context.md and context.meta.json are byte-identical (the index export bytes, fingerprint, and tier decision are all deterministic) (D-013-R037-style determinism)

path_free_justification: Paths bound at claim (2026-08-18) after M0-T064 acceptance, per the D-013 sequencing reservation (source-002). Decomposition of the 850-SLOC context_pack.py into focused modules + index consumption + the owner-approved adaptive-tier amendment.
